invalid_tangency_fallback: equal weights when normalization denominator is nonpositive or nonfinite
gross_cap_method: shrink normalized tangency weights toward equal weights until gross exposure <= 2
main_joint_sampling: independent Gaussian initial shocks; align path index across stocks
sensitivity_joint_sampling: initial shocks correlated by trailing 120-session return correlation with 0.1 diagonal shrinkage
price_timing: features at close t; rebalance at close t+1; first earned return ends t+2
macro_timing: strictly earlier calendar date; forward fill only; no backfill
target_purging: every 20-session target must end inside its assigned fit or validation split
checkpoint_selection: minimum validation noise-prediction MSE using fixed validation noise and times
return_scaling: per-stock mean and standard deviation fitted only through 2023-12-31
portfolio_accounting: buy and hold between 20-session rebalances; signed weights drift daily; zero risk-free rate
known_limits: Substitute universes, data vendors, architecture and optimization settings
Global regional universes are not verified index constituents
GICS classification uses the downloaded vendor snapshot
Main training uses nonoverlapping origins and reserves 2024 for validation
No test-dependent model, seed, ridge, or universe selection
No full reproduction of RL/generative competitor implementations or regime/sector appendix experiments
